priorityList: Ensure your pet is summoned before combat starts.
Cast Bestial Wrath as your primary offensive cooldown whenever available.
Combine Bestial Wrath with racial abilities like Berserking, Blood Fury, or Fireblood.
Use offensive potions and on-use trinkets (e.g., Algethar Puzzle Box, Light Company Guidon) during Bestial Wrath windows.
Cast Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath is about to come off cooldown (less than 1 GCD remaining) to maximize cooldown reduction.
Cast Kill Command as your highest priority filler, especially when Pack Leader buffs like Nature's Ally are active or Howl of the Pack is ready.
Cast Kill Command if it is not currently benefitting from an Apex Predator proc.
Cast Barbed Shot to maintain pet Frenzy stacks and continue reducing the cooldown of Bestial Wrath.
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler when Kill Command is on cooldown and you have available Focus.
